desc: Ideate the solution logic based on linearity of expectation and properties of sums of powers modulo $p$.
Determine that only walks with edge counts divisible by $p-1$ contribute non-zero sums.
Derive that for $p-1 > N$, only diagonal zeros $(i,i)$ with count $p-1$ and one other edge $(i,j)$ with count $1$ contribute.
Formulate the correction: if $A_{i,i}=0$, add $-A_{i,j}$ (mod $p$) if $A_{i,j} \neq 0$, else add $1$ (mod $p$).
Implement the matrix power function `mat_pow(A, p, mod)`.
Implement the main logic: read input, compute base power, apply corrections for diagonal zeros, and print output.
